timeline_disposition.reason: Gorampa Sonam Senge (1429–1489) is a securely historical Sakya philosopher whose documented intellectual and monastic career spans eastern and central Tibet, multiple teachers and institutions, and later service as the sixth Ngor Khenchen. The reviewed evidence establishes his life and philosophical importance but does not justify reducing that career to one exact canonical polity interval. ATLAS therefore retains the historical Person without manufacturing a single polity-bound Activity rail.

sources.title: Gorampa — Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy
sources.citation_text: SEP identifies Gorampa Sonam Senge (1429–1489) as one of the most widely studied philosophers of the Sakya school and details his Madhyamaka philosophy and Central Tibetan studies.

sources.title: Gorampa Sonam Sengge — The Treasury of Lives
sources.citation_text: The Treasury of Lives records Gorampa Sonam Sengge as a historical Sakya master, 1429–1489, associated with several institutions and teachers and later serving as the sixth Ngor Khenchen.
